evidence.reason: The function extracts the instance from the escaped unit filename and substitutes that same escaped text for both specifiers. systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance but `%I` as the unescaped instance, so `Service=%I.service` in `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket` should resolve to `crq-tick.service`, not `crq\x2dtick.service`. The current return leaves `%I` escaped and can drop the target-unit reference from the scan. This is an implementation defect in the intended expansion behavior, not a new requirement.
